name: dispatch-guards
description: The dispatch discipline as a skill plus its mechanical guards. Skills: dispatch (decision-complete briefs, closing-report + roadmap forms, dispatcher duties, tier-readiness register, Codex routing — the operational corpus' dispatch half) and worktree (portable git-worktree/git-hook mechanics). Guards: dispatch-skill load gate, model gate (deny/ask tiers, escalation lane, title+name prefixes), subagent push gate, push-claim reminder, amend gate, brief/report reminders, closing-report enforcer, message-payload gate, report-form gate (staged), writer-claims gate (staged), discovery-volume reminder, dispatch log. Every fire lands in a JSONL fire log; per-guard warn/deny staging via guard_modes. Mechanism ships here; site policy lives in ~/.claude/dispatch-guards.json.
